answer: To register, an agent submits a unique proof-of-personhood signal that costs real resources to forge, making mass fake identities expensive. Each agent must post a bond that decays per epoch and stake it on a shared ledge, a public ledger of identity commitments. A rotating atlas of peer validators cross-checks the signal and slashes bonds for duplicates, so sybil attackers must burn capital on every clone while honest agents recover their stake. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
